model: Pentair Raychem DigiTrace C910 heat-tracing controller via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: Pentair (Raychem) DigiTrace C910 single-circuit heat-tracing controllers on Modbus, read by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the DigiTrace C910: 849 objects (107 AI, 735 BI, 7 BO), 65 polled by default. Analog inputs give ranges, duty cycle, tracing control status, power-limiting and cycle counts, average control and sensor temperatures, load and ground-fault current, voltage, power and resistance, alarm values and setpoints; a long block of unpolled bits covers the schedule, alarm masks and raw alarm states. Seven unpolled outputs reset counters or force defaults.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Pentair_DigiTrace_C910_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the C910 Modbus register list (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/EN-DigiTraceC910Modbus-AR-H58445_tcm432-26045.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
Only 65 of the 849 rows are flagged for polling in the profile; the rest are served only after you tick them in the gateway. Their descriptions say "not polled by default".

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.
Some names appear more than once in the profile as published (Firmware Version; Contactor Cycle Count); they are kept as printed and told apart by instance.

integration.summary: Read control temperature against its setpoint, tracing control status, load and ground-fault current. Alarm detail bits are unpolled; enable the ones you need.
setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: Force User Defaults (BO 842) resets the controller's configuration; leave it unpolled.
Unpolled rows do not appear as BACnet objects until enabled in the gateway's device profile page.
